_comment: Free / copyright-free music sources. 'collections' are YouTube playlists or channels that yt-dlp expands at runtime (effectively unlimited tracks, always current). 'tracks' are individual curated fallbacks. CREDIT: NCS & Ninety9Lives require attribution in your video description; StreamBeats does not.

collections.name: NCS (NoCopyrightSounds)
StreamBeats (Harris Heller)
Ninety9Lives
Monstercat
collections.warning: Monstercat requires a Monstercat Gold license for monetized videos. Without it, your video may be claimed.
